appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize the logo, favicon, logo alignment and the selected item color in the sidebar menu
appearance.logoFormats: SVG, PNG, JPG, GIF or WEBP. Saved on the server.
appearance.sidebarColorHelp: Applies only to the selected item in the sidebar.
appearance.faviconFormats: ICO, PNG, SVG or GIF. Saved on the server.

info.urlOrUpload: You can provide an external URL or upload a file — the upload takes precedence.
info.appliedBefore: URL/color/alignment changes are applied when you click

download.title: Download Settings
download.description: Configure the default limits and behaviors of the download system
download.simultaneousDownloadsHelp: Maximum number of parallel downloads (1-10). Directly affects server processing.
download.ocrJobsHelp: Maximum number of parallel OCR jobs (1-5).
download.scansHelp: Maximum number of parallel directory scans (1-10).
download.ocrCleanupHelp: Minutes before deleting successfully finished OCR jobs. 0 = disabled.
download.depthLevelsHelp: Default value of the levels selector on the files screen (1-20).
download.maxFileSizeHelp: Default value of the maximum size selector on the files screen (1-1000 MB).

ignoredExtensions.title: Ignored Extensions
ignoredExtensions.description: File extensions that will be ignored in batch downloads. Manual downloads (Sync button) do not apply these filters.

info.item1: Files with these extensions will be automatically ignored in batch downloads ("Send to Queue" button)
info.item2: Manual downloads via the Sync button download any file, without applying filters
info.item3: Use it to avoid downloading log, temporary or backup files

importPorts.title: Import Ports
importPorts.description: Configure which ports are considered when importing servers via Nmap XML. Only hosts with these ports open will be imported.
importPorts.empty: No port configured - all hosts will be imported

info.dbText: MSSQL (1433), MySQL (3306), PostgreSQL (5432), Oracle (1521), MongoDB (27017), Redis (6379)
info.item4: Hosts without any of these ports open will be ignored during import
info.item5: You can add custom ports as needed

autoOcr.title: Auto OCR
autoOcr.description: Configure automatic OCR to extract text from files after download
autoOcr.toggleHelp: When enabled, downloaded files are automatically added to the OCR queue
autoOcr.extensionsHelp: Files with these extensions will be processed by OCR after download
autoOcr.mimetypesHelp: MIME types (partial) that trigger automatic OCR. E.g. "image/" captures all image types.
autoOcr.excludedHelpBefore: Files with these extensions will be
autoOcr.excludedHelpAfter: by automatic OCR, even if they are in the inclusion list.

info.item1: OCR runs in the background after the file is downloaded
info.item2: The extracted text becomes available for search and viewing
info.item3: Requires Apache Tika configured and running
info.item4: MIME types are checked with a partial match (e.g. "image/" captures "image/png", "image/jpeg", etc.)
info.item5After: over inclusions by extension or MIME type

autoIndex.title: Auto-Index
autoIndex.description: Automatic indexing of the raw content of text files when OCR does not run or fails
autoIndex.toggleHelp: Automatically index content of files not handled by OCR
autoIndex.maxSizeHelp: Files larger than this limit will not be indexed

info.item1: When OCR is skipped or fails, Auto-Index tries to read the raw content of the file
info.item2: The indexed content becomes available for search, just like the text extracted by OCR
info.item4: MIME types are checked with a partial match (e.g. "text/" captures "text/plain", "text/csv", etc.)
info.item5Strong: All files that are successfully processed by OCR will have their OCR content automatically indexed, regardless of this setting

generalInfo.title: About the Settings
generalInfo.simultaneousDownloadsText: Controls how many files are downloaded at the same time by the server. Higher values may overload the system.
generalInfo.depthLevelsText: Sets the default value shown in the selector on the files screen. The user can change it at download time.
generalInfo.maxFileSizeText: Sets the default value to ignore files larger than the limit. The user can change it at download time.
generalInfo.ignoredExtensionsText: Files with these extensions are automatically skipped in batch downloads.

toast.extensionExists: Extension already exists in the list
toast.portExists: Port already exists in the list

git.title: Git — Clone de Repositórios
git.description: Limits and concurrency for cloning, scanning and indexing GitHub repositories.
git.maxRepoSizeHelp: Repositories larger than this (by GitHub-reported size) are refused and the clone job fails. 0 = no limit.
git.shallowThresholdHelp: Repos larger than this are cloned shallow (--depth); smaller ones are cloned in full. 0 = always full.
git.simultaneousClonesHelp: How many repository clone jobs run in parallel.
git.indexMaxSizeHelp: Files larger than this are not text-extracted/indexed for content search.
